name: Banseiki pool: new leader gameplay records and single-player save/load

steps.code:
if not JAC_POOL_FILTER_INSTALLED or GameConfiguration.IsAnyMultiplayer() then error('single player pool hook required') end
local rows=DB.ConfigurationQuery('SELECT LeaderType FROM JAC_BanseikiPool')
if #rows~=300 then error('pool count '..#rows) end
local pool={}; for _,r in ipairs(rows) do pool[r.LeaderType]=true end
local p=CreatePlayerParameters(0,true); p:Refresh()
local count=0
for _,v in ipairs(p.Parameters.PlayerLeader.Values) do
 if pool[v.Value] then count=count+1 elseif v.Value~='RANDOM' then error('outside pool '..tostring(v.Value)) end
end
if count~=300 then error('human pool count '..count) end
return 'single human pool300'

local version=Game:GetProperty('JAC_BANSEIKI_POOL_LEDGER')
if type(version)~='string' or not version:match('^300:%x+$') then error('ledger missing') end
local pool={}; local count=0
for row in GameInfo.JAC_BanseikiPool() do pool[row.LeaderType]=row; count=count+1 end
if count~=300 then error('game ledger count '..count) end
local parts={version}; local expected={'LEADER_JAC_POOL_O008','LEADER_JAC_ODA_NOBUHIDE'}
for pid=0,1 do
 local p=Players[pid]; local c=PlayerConfigurations[pid]; local row=pool[expected[pid+1]]
 if not p or p:IsHuman()~=(pid==0) or c:GetLeaderTypeName()~=expected[pid+1] then error('player '..pid) end
 local id=p:GetProperty('JAC_POOL_PERSON_ID'); local trait=p:GetProperty('JAC_POOL_TRAIT'); local role=p:GetProperty('JAC_POOL_ROLE')
 if id~=row.PersonID or trait~=row.TraitType or role~='LEADER' or c:GetCivilizationTypeName()~=row.CivilizationType then error('person record '..pid..' '..tostring(id)) end
 parts[#parts+1]=table.concat({pid,c:GetLeaderTypeName(),id,trait,role},'|')
end
return table.concat(parts,';')
